title: NOT a 10 inch pie plate
text: NOT a 10 inch pie plate. I ordered these pie plates because I have a great recipe for pumpkin pie that needs a deep, 10" pie plate. This is NOT a 10" pie plate to American standards. It is actually smaller than the 8 1/2" pie plate that I have. True the outside top rim is approximately 10" but that is not what you are looking for in a large pie plate. Additionally, there is no rim around the top of the plate.
